scientific_integrity: The ordinary five-cycle exponent and general negative-type spectral principles are prior literature; only the evaluated all-parameter family, critical embedding ranks, and three asymptotic regimes are presented as the contribution. No external audit or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite five-cycle cluster metrics with five equal clusters, \(m\ge2\) and \(0<s\le2\) only. No assertion for unequal clusters or different base graphs. Numerical tests corroborate but do not prove uniform statements.
title: A three-regime roundness transition in five-cycle cluster metrics
